name: V-Squat
instructions: Stand on the platform of the V-squat machine facing the handles, with your shoulders under the pads and your feet about shoulder width apart.
Hold the handles, stand up to release the safety and take the weight.
Bend your knees and hips to lower yourself until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform. Keep your back against the pads.
Push through your whole foot to return to the start without locking your knees hard.
After the last repetition, put the safety back in place before you step out.
